items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-12-09
items.q: I do say to those that left here that, uh, married Dominick and, uh, not another fella who was born and raised

ctx.x: I mean, I was wondering maybe if there would be people who wouldn't have many family ties in that kind of country.

Well, you, you find it everywhere. Regardless if you're a musician or not. Uh, you got a guy that'll whamber, you know what I mean? You won't stay, he's restless. But he's a genius, boo, you know, and all that. And, um, I do say to those that left here that, uh, married Dominick and, uh, not another fella who was born and raised, and all he, they went with, cause, uh, salary was better. Uh, Chicago, he says, I still, still Chicago. You know, speedy, you know, uh, more work, better pay, that's all I can see. And…

That's why. Do you think, um, that, uh, this is another thing that I think maybe some people think, that, um, the musicians that did go to Chicago, would tend to be some of the best musicians? I think some people talk about it. Would you say that would be true?
